network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPACAL pubblica idrogrammi per alcuni corsi d'acqua regionali, incluso il Neto a Rocca di Neto, ma non una misura sullo Iornito compatibile con il ponte di Melissa. Il dato del Neto non viene trasferito a un corso d'acqua distinto.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPACAL report publishes hydrographs for selected regional watercourses, including the Neto at Rocca di Neto, but no Iornito measurement compatible with the Melissa bridge. The Neto value is not transferred to a different watercourse.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
